title: World Dance Fitness with Olga | "Learn Russian Dance!"

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down traditional folk steps clearly while counting out loud and demonstrating alongside a partner. She maintains an energetic, welcoming tone throughout the instruction.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of Olga and her partner Miray and context of the lesson.
Step 3: Open & close with triple step.

steps_taught.name: Walk Forward & Back
steps_taught.description: Walk forward four steps with a jump on four, then walk backward four steps.

steps_taught.name: Grapevine & Turn
steps_taught.description: Grapevine step to the side followed by a turn.

steps_taught.name: Open & Close with Triple Step
steps_taught.description: Arms open and close while feet perform a triple step.

steps_taught.name: Jump Rope
steps_taught.description: Leg lifts out to the side into a passé while stepping behind yourself repeatedly.

steps_taught.name: Toe, Heel, Jump X 3
steps_taught.description: Touch toe, touch heel, followed by three jumps on the same foot.

what_works: Breaking down the steps without music first
Demonstrating with a partner to show formations
what_hinders: Digital background overlay can make footwork slightly less distinct

quotes.text: we're going to teach you some easy steps for Russian folk dance.
we're going to explain the steps to you without music first.
let's put it to music. Here we go.

evidence_segments.observation: Walking forward with arms crossed over chest and tilting body toward the stepping foot.
Grapevine step with arms extended to the sides.
Jump rope step with hands on hips and alternating leg lifts behind.

extraction.distinctive_method: Explaining the Russian translation and cultural meaning of steps like 'verevochka' (jump rope) during the breakdown.
